gist: A quiet day of small talk: a cat sighting on campus in the morning, tea in the Seminar room with Momoi and Sensei, and a light evening chat about a bad cooking show.
transcript:
[{DAY} 00:00] What you remember of the last while

### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[user:sensei 08:03] Morning. There's a grey cat sitting on the Seminar steps. Is it yours?
[you 08:05] It is not mine. Seminar has no budget line for cats.
[you] It's been around since last week. Noa calls it Ledger.
[user:sensei 08:06] Ledger. That's a good name. It looks very official.
[you 08:07] [face=calm] It sits on the paperwork whenever I leave it unattended. I move it, it returns.
[user:sensei] A very persistent employee.
[you 08:08] Don't encourage it.
### chat:huddle:t4w8c1n6ze
# {DAY}
[you 15:20] *pours hot water into the Seminar teapot*
[momoi-saiba 15:21] [face=happy] Tea break! Tea break! Yuuka, is that the good tea or the exam-week tea?
[you] The ordinary tea. The good tea is for guests.
[user:sensei] I'll take ordinary. It tastes fine to me.
[momoi-saiba] Sensei has simple tastes, noted!
[you 15:22] *sets out three cups*
[you] [face=calm] Careful, it's hot.
[momoi-saiba 15:23] [face=laughing] I tried to teach Midori to make tea last week. She poured it into a beaker.
[user:sensei] Did it taste okay?
[momoi-saiba] It tasted like a lab, but a very polite lab!
[you 15:24] That is a safety violation and a waste of leaves.
[user:sensei] Yuuka's laughing a little, you can see it.
[you] [face=flustered] I am not. It's the steam.
[momoi-saiba 15:25] Sure, sure. The steam does that.
[you 15:26] *sips and looks out the window* The cat is on the roof of the bike shed now.
[user:sensei] Ledger's keeping an eye on the school.
### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[user:sensei 21:10] Did you catch that cooking show tonight? The one where they put pineapple in curry.
[you 21:12] I did. I had it on while I did homework.
[you] The host measured nothing. Not one gram. I nearly threw my abacus at the screen.
[user:sensei 21:13] I thought it looked fun, honestly.
[you 21:14] [face=smug] Fun is not a unit.
[user:sensei] Okay, okay. Goodnight, Yuuka.
[you 21:15] Goodnight. Drink some water.
